label: StudySH-EP Orin 4BI server launch, per user ruling 2026-11-20
ruling: Run the full 4BI sweep with the Jetson vLLM deployment DEFAULT configuration; do not change deployment defaults; record the exact launch command and classify each flag; drop study-only additions unless needed for parity (mm-processor settings stay matched to the H100).
launch_command: vllm serve <SNAP Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct> --served-model-name qwen3vl4b Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct --max-num-seqs 1 --enable-prefix-caching --dtype bfloat16 --max-model-len 32768 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":21,"video":0}' --gpu-memory-utilization 0.4 --enforce-eager --mm-processor-kwargs '{"size": {"shortest_edge": 4096, "longest_edge": 16777216}, "fps": 1.0, "do_sample_frames": false}' --enable-prompt-tokens-details --seed 0 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
env_note: FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 is an ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENT for this box, not a study tuning flag: the Orin venv has a flashinfer version-string mismatch (flashinfer-cubin 0.6.13 vs flashinfer 0.6.15.post1) that otherwise aborts vLLM startup. It bypasses the version-string check only; the installed flashinfer is functional. No effect on compute, tokens, or timing. The attention backend is left to the deployment default auto-selection (orin3_serve.sh sets no VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND).

flags.--max-num-seqs 1: JETSON DEFAULT (serial, one request at a time)
flags.--enable-prefix-caching: JETSON DEFAULT (prefix/KV cache ON; source of cached_tokens)
flags.--enforce-eager: JETSON DEFAULT (ENFORCE_EAGER defaults to 1 in orin3_serve.sh). Device timings are therefore eager-mode and labelled accordingly.
flags.mm-processor-cache-gb (unset): JETSON DEFAULT: not set by the deployment launcher, so the vLLM default of 4 GiB applies; the multimodal processor cache is ON, which is what the uuid-only delta mode resolves against.
flags.--served-model-name qwen3vl4b Qwen/Qwen3: ADDED (functional): HF id added as a second served name because the kit runner addresses the model by its HF id. No compute effect.
flags.--limit-mm-per-prompt {image:21}: ADDED (required): deployment default is image:9; EP-G carries up to 21 images so the sweep cannot run at 9. Admission cap only; no per-request token or compute effect for requests within it.
flags.--mm-processor-kwargs {size:{shortest_ed: ADDED (PARITY): matched to the H100 byte for byte; sets the image token count that the cross-stack comparison depends on.
flags.--enable-prompt-tokens-details: ADDED (instrumentation): makes prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens appear in the response so the runner can record it. Response reporting only, no compute or timing effect.

dropped_study_only_flags: --trust-request-mm-kwargs (absent in Orin vLLM 0.20.0; the runner sends no per-request mm_processor_kwargs so it is inert; gate confirmed exact token parity without it)
--kv-offloading-backend/--kv-offloading-size (H100 capacity feature; the Orin is unified memory so CPU KV offload is the same pool)
FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK / VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND / VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER (not set by the Jetson deployment launcher)
--enable-log-requests / --enable-logging-iteration-details (verbose logging added only for earlier diagnosis)
cached_tokens_recording: Raw records keep cached_tokens ABSENT (null) where the field is missing (cold first instant of an episode on this build); it is NOT mapped to 0. cached_tokens_present separates an absent field from a present 0.
parity_evidence: EP-G 5-clip gate: 65/65 exact prompt-token match to the H100 precheck; re-verified under this exact launch config before the sweep.
